info.title: PayPetal Merchant API
info.description:
The PayPetal Merchant API lets you accept payments, manage customers, and hold funds in escrow through a single REST interface.

**Authentication:** All protected endpoints require a JWT Bearer token obtained from `POST /api/auth/login`. Tokens are valid for 7 days.

**Base64 credential format:** `base64(secretKey:appId)`

**Two escrow products:**
- **TrustCore** — merchant-controlled escrow: you decide when to release or refund funds.
- **TrustVault** — customer-controlled escrow: funds release when the customer supplies a one-time code.

tags.name: TrustVault Escrow
tags.description: TrustVault is a customer-controlled escrow product. A customer funds an agreement through a hosted payment link; funds are released only when the customer supplies a one-time authorization code sent to their email. Your server does not trigger the release — the customer does.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Manage the end-users registered under your merchant account. Customers are required as participants in TrustCore escrow agreements.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Generate hosted payment links and verify transaction status. The customer is redirected to a PayPetal-hosted page to complete payment from their wallet. **Rate limit:** 60 requests per 60-second window per merchant on POST /pay/initiate.

tags.name: TrustCore Payout Accounts
tags.description: Manage customer bank payout accounts for TrustCore escrow

tags.name: TrustCore Escrow
tags.description: TrustCore is PayPetal's merchant-controlled escrow product. Merchants initiate an agreement on behalf of a customer, generating a secure payment link. The customer funds the escrow through that link, and the merchant holds full control over when funds are released — enabling safe, trust-based transactions between buyers and sellers.

put.description: Releases the escrowed funds to the merchant using the one-time authorization code the customer received by email. The code is obtained by first calling `PUT /agreement/auth/{reference}`.

put.description: Sends a one-time authorization code to the customer's registered email address. The customer must supply this code to `PUT /agreement/complete/{reference}` to release the funds. Call this endpoint when the customer is ready to approve the release.

put.description: Returns the escrowed amount to the initiator (payer). The initiator must have a payout bank account on file (add one via `POST /api/v1/escrow/trustcore/payout/{customerId}`). Triggers the `trustcore.payment.refund` webhook on success. Cannot be called if funds have already been paid out, a payout is in progress, or a refund has already been issued.

post.description:
Creates a pending payment transaction and returns a hosted payment URL. Redirect your customer to `paymentUrl` to complete payment through their PayPetal wallet.

**Idempotency:** supplying a `transactionId` that already exists for a pending transaction returns the existing record instead of creating a new one.

**Rate limit:** 60 requests per 60-second window. Exceeding this returns HTTP 429.

200.description: Payment initiated — redirect the customer to the returned `paymentUrl`.

400.description: Validation error or business profile incomplete.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired Bearer token.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded. Parse the retry delay from the response message.

example.message: You have exceeded the allowed number of requests. Try again in 45 second(s).

400.description: Validation error, customer not found, or duplicate idempotency key with conflicting data.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired Bearer token.

CompleteAgreementDto.description: Authorization code required to complete a TrustVault escrow release

bankCode.description: CBN bank code. Retrieve the full list from GET /api/v1/account/banks.

AccountDto.description: Bank payout account details. The account number must be pre-validated via POST /api/v1/account/bank/validate before linking.

phoneNumber.description: Customer's phone number in international format.

amount.description: Amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g. kobo for NGN, cents for USD).

transactionId.description: Your unique reference for this payment (minimum 14 characters). If omitted, PayPetal generates one. Reusing a reference that belongs to an existing pending transaction returns that transaction instead of creating a new one.

description.description: Human-readable description shown on the payment page.

redirectUrl.description: URL the customer is redirected to after payment completes.

additionalProperties.description: Arbitrary key-value data stored with the transaction and returned in webhooks and verify calls unchanged.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value data stored with the transaction and returned in webhooks and verify calls unchanged.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key supplied by your platform. Reusing a key returns the original agreement instead of creating a new one (idempotent).

customerId.description: The `customerId` of the customer funding the escrow. Must exist on your merchant account.

amount.description: Amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g. kobo for NGN).

type.description: Agreement type. `ONETIME` for a single payment; `MILESTONE` for staged releases. When `MILESTONE`, the `milestone` field is required.

feePayer.description: Who bears the PayPetal system fee. `SENDER` adds the fee to the amount the customer pays; `RECEIVER` deducts it from the payout.

description.description: Description of the goods or services covered by this agreement.

redirectUrl.description: URL the customer is redirected to after successfully funding the escrow.

additionalProperties.description: Arbitrary key-value data stored with the agreement and returned in responses and webhooks unchanged.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value data stored with the agreement and returned in responses and webhooks unchanged.

amount.description: If amount is not set, then percentage must be set

referenceId.description: A unique reference generated by your platform to identify this escrow transaction. This value must be unique for every transaction and is used for reconciliation and tracking.

initiator.description: The unique identifier of the customer initiating the escrow payment. This customer must exist on your platform.

counterparty.description: The unique identifier of the customer recieving the escrow payment. This customer must exist on your platform.

currency.description: The currency used for the escrow transaction.

amount.description: The escrow amount in the smallest currency unit. For example, NGN should be supplied in kobo.

merchantCharge.description: The additional amount your platform charges your customer as your own commission or service fee. This amount is collected on your behalf and is separate from the PayPetal system fee. Set to 0 or omit this field if you do not want to charge an additional amount.

description.description: A brief description of the goods or services covered by this escrow transaction. This description is visible throughout the transaction lifecycle.
description.example: Payment for iPhone 15 Pro Max, 256GB, Space Black

redirectUrl.description: The URL to which the customer is redirected after successfully funding the escrow. This URL should be handled by your application.

additionalProperties.description: Optional custom data associated with the transaction. TrustCore stores this information and returns it in responses and webhooks without modifying it.

metadata.description: Optional custom data associated with the transaction. TrustCore stores this information and returns it in responses and webhooks without modifying it.

InitiateTrustCoreDto.description: Creates a new TrustCore escrow transaction. TrustCore allows your platform to manage the complete escrow experience while PayPetal securely holds and releases funds. You may optionally specify a merchant charge to earn additional revenue from the transaction. PayPetal system fees are calculated separately based on your merchant fee settings, including who is configured to bear the system fee.

bankCode.description: CBN bank code. Retrieve the full list from GET /api/v1/account/banks.

base64Hashed.description: Base64 encoding of your credentials in the format `secretKey:appId`. Example: `base64('sk_live_abc123:app_xyz789')` → `'c2tfbGl2ZV9hYmMxMjM6YXBwX3h5ejc4OQ=='`

LoginDto.description: Authentication request. Encode your credentials as base64(secretKey:appId) before submitting.

BearerAuth.description: JWT obtained from POST /api/auth/login. Valid for 7 days. Format: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
